about: The static site's pages. vite.config.ts builds exactly these and writes sitemap.xml from them, one <url> per page with its lastmod. lastmod is the date the page's content last changed, set by hand, never later than the build date (the build refuses a later one). indexnow_key names the key file in public/ (<key>.txt, whose content is the key): public by design, it lets IndexNow check that a submission comes from this host (scripts/indexnow.mjs).
